The '''Dark Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] in the [[Dominus sector/Legends|Dominus sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Dark Nebula (Star Destroyer)|''Dark Nebula'']], a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Planets">''[[The Star Wars Planets Collection]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Dark Nebula was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in in grid square U-7.<ref name="TEA" />
